ordered_step_reconstruction: At the symmetric midpoint, antisymmetry and eigenfunction parity kill the diagonal perturbation matrix element, so lambda_k'=0 and only opposite parity contributes.
Differentiate the affine generalized eigenproblem twice to obtain lambda_k''=2lambda_k^2 sum_(j!=k)(integral h u_ku_j)^2/(lambda_k-lambda_j).

Set c=(R+1)/2 and H=R-1 to realize reflected admissible one-interface endpoints and infer only the scoped all-n arbitrary-chord no-go.
